name: SolveTriangle
comment: Solves one triangle from sides a and b and the included angle C in degrees (SAS). output is a, b, c, AngleA, AngleB, or AngleC. Angles are degrees from 0 to 180. An unknown output name returns a message. A zero side on a requested angle returns #DIV/0!. Last Update at 2026-11-03.
